evals.prompt: Add what we just learned about the deploy pipeline to the wiki, then tell me what the wiki already says about auth.
evals.expected_output: Ingest with the documented shape: wiki_ingest({ title, content, tags, category }) — one ingest may touch multiple pages. Then query with wiki_query({ query, tags, category }), which returns matching pages with snippets, and the answer is synthesized by the LLM with citations from those results. Notes the hard constraint: no vector embeddings — keyword + tag matching only.

evals.prompt: The wiki feels messy after a few weeks of sessions. Check its health.
evals.expected_output: Runs wiki_lint() and reports its detections by category: orphan pages, stale content, broken cross-references, oversized pages, structural contradictions. Points at the storage layout: pages .omc/wiki/*.md (markdown with YAML frontmatter), index.md auto-maintained catalog, log.md append-only chronicle; cross-references use [[page-name]] syntax.

evals.prompt: How do I add one quick page, list everything, read a single page, and delete an outdated one?
evals.expected_output: Names the four operations precisely: wiki_add({ title, content, tags, category }) for a single quick page (simpler than ingest), wiki_list() (reads index.md), wiki_read({ page }), wiki_delete({ page }). Mentions the category set (architecture, decision, pattern, debugging, environment, session-log) and that pages are git-ignored by default, project-local under .omc/wiki/.
